'''Mount Meru''' was a mountain on [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] held the [[Conclave at Deneba]] there<ref name="DLOTS3" /> in [[3997 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Krath Holy Crusade]].<ref name="DLOTS3" />
